77776.subject: Trump Says the CFTC Is Working to Onshore Hyperliquid
77776.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Trump](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/trump-says-cftc-working-to-onshore-hyperliquid)**[ says the CFTC is working to onshore Hyperliquid](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/trump-says-cftc-working-to-onshore-hyperliquid)

* **[Optimism](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/optimism-redirects-49-7-million-airdrop-reserve-after-late-deciding-vote)**[ hands its $49.7 million airdrop reserve to the Foundation](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/optimism-redirects-49-7-million-airdrop-reserve-after-late-deciding-vote)

* **[Arbitrum](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/arbitrum-activates-elara-with-optional-compliance-filters-for-dedicated-chains)**[ ships optional compliance filters with the Elara upgrade](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/arbitrum-activates-elara-with-optional-compliance-filters-for-dedicated-chains)

* **[Vlad Tenev](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/vlad-tenev-pushes-for-tokenized-stocks-in-america)**[ presses Washington to let tokenized stocks trade in America](https://thedefiant.io/news/tradfi-and-fintech/vlad-tenev-pushes-for-tokenized-stocks-in-america)

* **[Aligned](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/aligned-details-align-airdrop-still-no-launch-date)**[ details the ALIGN airdrop 20 months on, with no launch date](https://thedefiant.io/news/tokens/aligned-details-align-airdrop-still-no-launch-date)

* **[Why DeFi Needs Onchain Insurance: The $100 Billion Coverage Gap [PARTNER] ](https://thedefiant.io/education/research-and-opinion/defi-needs-onchain-insurance-100-billion-coverage-gap)**

Hyperliquid has never taken a US retail order. On Wednesday the president said the CFTC is working to change that.

Trump told a White House audience that included ICE Chief Executive Jeffrey Sprecher, Nasdaq's Adena Friedman and Robinhood's Vlad Tenev that [CFTC Chair Michael Selig is working to bring Hyperliquid into the United States "in a fully compliant and legal fashion."](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/trump-says-cftc-working-to-onshore-hyperliquid) HYPE traded near $69.56 late Wednesday, up about 19% over 24 hours. Hyperliquid Strategies, the Nasdaq-listed treasury company, closed up 30.4% at $9.39, its largest single-day gain on record. CME Group and Cboe Global Markets closed down 1.7% and 3.5%.

Sprecher's company and CME spent the spring pressing regulators to bring the venue under federal supervision, and CME's suit against the CFTC over the Kalshi perpetuals approval is still pending. Hyperliquid cleared $177.9 billion in perpetuals volume over the past 30 days without a single US retail account. Nothing Trump said commits the agency to a timetable, and no registration application has surfaced.

----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/52bd4e9f-8d48-4afc-bcfb-24724d4dec46/unnamed.png?t=1787259658)
Caption: 

# Thursday links: Is crypto back? Already??

[NFTs that own stocks](https://blockworks-research.beehiiv.com/p/nfts-that-own-stocks?_bhlid=c6a19231727a266c31aca9e4194b53b90c1cb475)

The [0xResearch newsletter](https://blockworks.com/newsletter/0xresearch) notes that the floor price of [StonkBrokers NFTs](https://opensea.io/collection/stonkbrokers-434284142) has surged from less than $400 a month ago to $13,000 today.

The NFTs are represented by pixelated stock brokers. But the artwork is not what’s made them the second-most valuable NFTs on OpenSea (behind CryptoPunks and ahead of Bored Apes). 

Instead, it’s because each NFT is also a wallet that can hold crypto assets, including tokenized stocks. 

Each NFT receives a randomly selected tokenized stock when it's minted (SpaceX, say, or Amazon). When it’s also “activated” (for a fee, paid in the StonkBroker token), it receives additional stocks that the protocol buys with the fees it earns. Holders can also send stocks they buy themselves to the NFT’s wallet. (I think. It’s kind of [complicated](https://www.stonkbrokers.cash/docs?utm_source=chatgpt.com).)

When an NFT is sold, everything in the wallet moves with it.

0xResearch describes the mechanics as an attempt to connect “NFTs, tokenized equities, a liquid token, a launchpad and an exchange into one financial ecosystem.”

I’m not sure it will work — so far, the pixelated stock brokers appear to be priced entirely on their speculative value and not the assets they hold (the interesting part).

But it’s fun to see something new and ambitious happening with NFTs.

Also, it got me to look at OpenSea for the first time in about three years. (I was kind of surprised it was still there.)

Is this what an NFT comeback would look like?

Maybe!

[Are memecoins back?](https://app.blockworksresearch.com/analytics/fomo)

Another ambitious new project in crypto is fomo.family — a trading app that aims to become a social media platform by bringing people together over their love for memecoins.

Caption:

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
